{"search_note":"I did not find strong 2024 proof that Jokowi’s core ministries were dominated by family members, cronies, or donors in the literal cabinet sense.

The clearest positive evidence is sector-specific and technocratic, especially finance.

The clearest negative evidence is political patronage and loyalist placement around the presidency and coalition, rather than a full cabinet of obvious cronies.

So the best synthesis is: competent professionals remained in important economic posts, but Jokowi’s broader governing style still relied heavily on loyalists and influence-preserving appointments.","evidence":[{"title":"Indonesia markets rattled by election uncertainty, finance minister’s future","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-02-01","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/analysisindonesian-markets-rattled-by-election-uncertainty-finance-ministers-future-3289355","summary":"Reuters described Sri Mulyani as a highly regarded finance minister and said the finance ministry kept working normally despite succession noise. This is strong evidence that Jokowi retained a competent professional with real standing.","question_ids":["7B.5","7B.4"]},{"title":"IMF staff completes 2024 Article IV mission to Indonesia","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-06-14","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/06/14/pr24221-imf-staff-completes-2024-article-iv-mission-to-indonesia","summary":"IMF said Indonesia’s fiscal and monetary frameworks remained prudent, credible, and shock-ready.
